tbe_ir_audit.explanation: All metadata addresses inside persistent run loop depend on local_id/run_id/feature ID; per-entry embedding output offsets depend on varying info values. Immutability alone does not establish invariant addresses. num_runs already loaded before loops. Prototype supports only constant initial while conditions, which is an implementation restriction, but no constant-address metadata load is visibly stranded solely by that restriction in these kernels. Shared physical table does not imply shared feature ID or embedding output offset.

aggregation_rule: For each variant/config, median of the three seed medians; choose one fixed best config per variant using those medians; report baseline-best/variant-best. Per-seed ratios below reuse those fixed selected configurations.
mamba_resource_interpretation: Measured compiler resource metadata shows additional scan register/shared-memory cost. With full state dimensions the sequential baseline already has many CTAs; this is consistent with extra scan work outweighing added parallelism. No hardware-counter bottleneck attribution is claimed.

Prefer these supplemental representative-shape figures over the initial narrow scan sweep.
